name: io.github.pacocartones/free-llm-api-hub
title: Free LLM API Hub
description: Search free LLM API tiers, read an entry, get an OpenAI client config. Read-only, unaffiliated.

environmentVariables.name: FLAH_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a local providers.json instead of fetching https://freellmapihub.com/api/v1/providers.json

environmentVariables.name: FLAH_CLIENTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a local openai-clients.json instead of fetching the published file
